faqs.a:
(a)
Entry of judgment.
The court shall have authority to enter judgment by default against any defendant
               charged with a noncriminal traffic infraction who fails to appear in court or otherwise
               answer as directed by the summons and complaint served upon the defendant on the date
               and time the defendant is scheduled for trial or hearing.
(b)
Fines and costs.
The municipal court shall assess fines and court costs according to the published
               fine schedule for the original charge as if the defendant were convicted at trial.
(c)
Record of judgment.
The record of a default judgment including original charge, points associated with
               said charge, and amount owed shall be forwarded to the Colorado Division of Motor
               Vehicles.
(d)
Setting aside judgment.
The court may set aside a judgment entered under this section on a showing of good
               cause or excusable neglect by the defendant. The court shall have no jurisdiction
               to set aside a judgment after seven calendar days after the entry of judgment.
(e)
Warrants.
No warrants shall be issued for the arrest of a defendant who fails to appear for
               a noncriminal traffic infraction and against whom an entry of judgment has been entered.
(
Ord. No. 4453, § 1, 8-4-2014
)
